app.subtitle: Remote support
client.explain: Press the button — the app will show a temporary ID and password. Share them with your support specialist in the chat.
client.idleNote: Connection is established only with your consent
client.leadHtml:
Fast and safe help
at a distance
tile.easySub: Just share the ID and password
client.waitNote: Waiting for the operator to connect… The password works once and only until the session ends.
client.consentIntroHtml: Operator — asks for access to your screen.
client.consentNote: Only allow people you are expecting. You can end access at any moment with the “End session” button.
client.connectedIntroHtml: The operator now sees your screen: —.
client.pausedNote: Broadcast paused — the operator cannot see your screen.
client.endedByYou: You have ended access. Start a new request to get help again.
client.noSources: No screens found: screen recording permission is missing or capture is unavailable
client.pickSubtitle: Pick a screen or a window.
client.permMac: Allow screen recording: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording, then restart EnotDesk.
client.permOther: Screen capture is blocked by the system. Grant the permission and try again.
op.noAccount: No account? Ask your team administrator to send you an invitation.
op.inviteDone: Done! Now sign in with your login and password.
op.pasteHint: You can paste the full access details — ID and password will fill in automatically
op.pasteHintDone: ID and password are filled in — check them and press “Connect”
op.waitingConfirm: Waiting for the client to approve…
op.controlNote: Mouse and keyboard control is active until the client ends the session.
password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Active sessions with your participation have been ended.
settings.title: Settings
settings.allowHttpNote: Traffic is not encrypted — suitable only for a test server, not for the internet.
settings.firstRun: First run: enter the EnotDesk server address.
settings.serverBad: Server returned an error — check the address
settings.macosScreen: Screen recording is not allowed on macOS — enable it in System Settings.
settings.nativeInput: Native input is unavailable: mouse/keyboard control will not work.
settings.updateBanner: Version {version} is available — update the client from the downloads page of your EnotDesk server.
update.autoBanner: Version {version} is available — the update downloads and applies when EnotDesk restarts.
update.manualBanner: Version {version} is available — download the new build from the project releases page.
contacts.title: Address book
contacts.empty: The book is empty. Press “Add” to create the first contact.
contacts.conflict: The contact was changed by someone else. Check the current version and retry.
team.title: Team
team.empty: The team is empty. Create an invitation below and send it to a colleague.
team.invitesEmpty: No active invitations. Create a one-time invitation and share it in a chat.
history.title: Session history
history.empty: History is empty. Completed support sessions will appear here.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.empty: The log is empty. Team actions will be recorded here automatically.
end.host-lost: The help app was closed — session ended.
end.lease-expired: Session ended due to inactivity timeout.
end.server-restart: The server was restarted — session ended.
end.signal-lost: Connection to the server was lost — session ended.
files.fromOperator: The operator sends file “{name}” ({size} MB). Accept?
files.broken: File was received with an error — transfer interrupted.
files.brokenShort: File was received with an error
server.hero.lead: Fast and secure access to your device. The app runs without installation, and the password works only while it is open.
server.mascotAlt: EnotDesk raccoon in headphones and glasses at a laptop
server.step1.title: Get the link
server.step1.text: The support specialist will send you a link to this page in a chat.
server.step2.title: Run the app
server.step2.text: Download the file and open it — no installation needed.
server.step3.title: Share the ID and password
server.step3.text: The app will show an ID and a one-time password — tell them to the specialist.
server.step4.title: Connect and finish
server.step4.text: The specialist connects and helps. Close the app — access ends immediately.
server.invite.title: Invitation to the EnotDesk team
server.invite.lead: You have been invited to a support team. Open the EnotDesk app and paste the invitation code from the message into the invitation form.
server.invite.note: If the app is not installed yet, download a suitable build on the downloads page.
web.title: EnotDesk — web operator
web.login.title: Operator sign in
web.login.lead: The same account as in the desktop app: sign in, connect by ID/password, client consent — no installation.
web.login.auditor: Auditors have read-only access — the web operator is unavailable for this role.
web.denied.title: Not enough permissions
web.denied.lead: The web operator is available to the operator and admin roles. Auditors should use the desktop app.
web.connect.title: Connect to a client
web.waiting.title: Waiting for the client's consent
web.waiting.note: The client sees your name and must approve access.
web.reconnect.title: Connection lost. The session is still within the grace period — try to come back.
web.chat.title: Chat
web.clip.title: Clipboard
web.clip.hint: Copied text is sent to the other side. The browser will ask for clipboard permission.
web.files.title: Files
web.files.drop: Drop a file onto the session screen
server.insecureBanner: Connection is not secure — set up HTTPS before using it over the internet (see docs/SERVER.md)
machines.revoked: Machine has been revoked by the administrator
machines.notRegistered: Machine has not registered with an onboarding code yet
machines.busy: Machine is already in a session
machines.reasonRequired: State the reason for connecting (up to 500 characters)
machines.revokeNotFound: Machine not found or already revoked
machines.badCode: The code is invalid or has already been used
machines.noSession: The machine has no active session
